issues.reason: Events forbids coining relation heads outright ('a verb, noun or adjective from the sentence never becomes a new UpperCamelCase head'), and (Meaning ...) is a head minted from the participle 'meaning'.

The lost link to sk_evidence_1 is a coverage gap (a finite that-clause complement of a noun has no licensed encoding), but the half that stands is that the hate bundle sits as a bare conjunct of the sealed said-proposition, making the record say Imron asserted that they hate Islam when the text says only that evidence of it should be had.

Inside the seal (Member sk_clear_1 clear) + (Experiencer sk_clear_1 sk_target_1) states the target IS clear, over-asserting a text that says it must be; a deontic over an eventuality is the licensed (Obligated e) status atom.

'really' is an intensifier, not a manner adverb (Manner keeps the surface manner adverb, e.g. brightly), and the instruction set directs that an unrepresentable adverbial be left out rather than mis-slotted.

The parser used the licensed operator for 'should' (Obligated); that a seal carries one outer TV so the 0.7 strength cannot be recorded is the coverage gap the reviewer itself lists, not a parse defect (calibration line).

gaps_confirmed: finite that-clause complement of a noun ('evidence ... that they really hate Islam') has no licensed encoding
of-phrase on a noun that is neither a nominalization nor a true relational noun ('evidence of the target')
intensifier / degree adverb modifying a verb ('really hate') - Degree is defined over adjectives only
first-person plural 'we' - the no-antecedent pronoun rule enumerates only he/she/they/it
no per-conjunct truth values inside a seal, so a 0.7 'should' or a lowered confidence cannot be recorded
direct quotation as an attitude complement (the attitude section covers finite that-clauses)
a framing/domain PP scoping over a copular clause ('In jihad, the target must be clear') has no listed reification trigger to anchor In
new_gaps: 'meaning that P' - a clause-level elaborating participle relating two propositions has no licensed head; the connective lexicon is closed to cause / purpose / concession / contrast, so the relation can only be dropped
repair_summary: Dropped the coined (Meaning sk_clear_1 sk_have_1) head, no licensed replacement existing. Added (Obligated sk_clear_1) to the reified 'clear' state so the sealed record says the target must be clear rather than that it is. Removed the unsubordinated hate bundle (Member/Experiencer/Stimulus) together with its mis-slotted (Manner sk_hate_1 really) atom, recording the noun-complement gap.
notes: The say/seal skeleton, the top-level projection of the definite 'the target', the 'we' group witness and the entity-attached (Of ...) are all acceptable improvisation in gap territory.
